notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
description:
Activate a Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
Resolve the Clue ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Human Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
The Human Warrior dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Repeat.
